title: Registrants at Savoy Male and Female College Ex-Students' Reunion
text:
REGISTRANTS AT SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE EX-STUDENTS' REUNION AT SAVOY, TEXAS, AUGUST 6 AND 7, 1938

Compiled from the official registration cards of the ex-students and visitors attending the Savoy Male and Female College Ex-Students' Reunion, August 6 and 7, 1938, in Savoy, Texas.

*Living former family members.

(Given are the name, present address and years in College.)

Alexander, Mrs. Flo Smith, Nocona, Texas, 1884-1888

notes: Alphabetical registrant list (A-B). Some surnames/years uncertain at scan resolution, marked [?]. Note Mattie Lee Boyd (the thesis author) is listed as granddaughter of James Paxton; Pamela Paxton Boyd was her mother.
